user.title: Woow HA Records
user.description: Adds finance, asset, health and note records. Accounts, members, assets and notes are created afterwards from the panels or services.

finance_get_accounts.name: Get Accounts
finance_get_accounts.description: List all financial accounts with their current balance.

finance_get_account.name: Get Account
finance_get_account.description: Get full details of a specific account including transactions and recurring plans.

finance_get_chart_data.name: Get Chart Data
finance_get_chart_data.description: Get monthly income vs. expense chart data for an account.

finance_export_csv.name: Export CSV
finance_export_csv.description: Export all transactions for an account as CSV text.

finance_add_transaction.name: Add Transaction
finance_add_transaction.description: Record a new transaction (income or expense) to an account.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Transaction amount. Positive for income, negative for expense.

finance_update_transaction.name: Update Transaction
finance_update_transaction.description: Modify an existing transaction's amount and/or note. Balance is adjusted by the difference.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: New amount. Balance is adjusted by the difference from the old amount.

finance_delete_transaction.name: Delete Transaction
finance_delete_transaction.description: Delete a transaction and revert its effect on the account balance.

finance_add_plan.name: Add Recurring Plan
finance_add_plan.description: Create a new recurring income/expense plan that auto-executes on schedule.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Recurring amount. Positive for income, negative for expense.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: Recurrence: daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

day.name: Day
day.description: Day of recurrence. 1-28 for monthly/yearly, 1-7 (Mon-Sun) for weekly.

month.name: Month
month.description: Month (1-12) for yearly frequency only. Default 1.

active.name: Active
active.description: Whether the plan is active on creation. Default true.

finance_update_plan.name: Update Recurring Plan
finance_update_plan.description: Modify an existing recurring plan's settings.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: New frequency: daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

finance_delete_plan.name: Delete Recurring Plan
finance_delete_plan.description: Remove a recurring plan and its associated sensor entities.

finance_add_account.name: Add Account
finance_add_account.description: Create a new financial account with optional initial balance.

finance_update_account.name: Update Account
finance_update_account.description: Rename an account or update its remark.

name.name: Name
name.description: New account name. Cannot be empty or duplicate.

finance_delete_account.name: Delete Account
finance_delete_account.description: Delete an account and all its transactions, plans, and sensor entities.

finance_adjust_balance.name: Adjust Balance
finance_adjust_balance.description: Set an account's balance to a specific value. Creates an adjustment transaction for the difference.

asset_list_assets.name: List Assets
asset_list_assets.description: List all assets and asset categories.

asset_get_asset.name: Get Asset
asset_get_asset.description: Get full details of a specific asset.

asset_export_csv.name: Export CSV
asset_export_csv.description: Export all assets as CSV text.

asset_create_asset.name: Create Asset
asset_create_asset.description: Create a new asset. Only the name is required.

category_id.name: Category ID
category_id.description: The category to file the asset under. Leave empty for uncategorized.

value.name: Value
value.description: Monetary value or purchase price. Default 0.

manual_md.name: Manual
manual_md.description: Markdown text for the user manual or operating instructions.

maintenance_md.name: Maintenance
maintenance_md.description: Markdown text for the maintenance schedule and service history.

asset_update_asset.name: Update Asset
asset_update_asset.description: Modify one or more fields on an existing asset. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

name.name: Name
name.description: New asset name. Cannot be empty.

purchase_at.name: Purchase Date
purchase_at.description: New purchase date (ISO 8601). Pass an empty string to clear.

warranty_until.name: Warranty Expiry
warranty_until.description: New warranty expiry date (ISO 8601). Pass an empty string to clear.

manual_md.name: Manual
manual_md.description: New manual text. Pass an empty string to clear.

maintenance_md.name: Maintenance
maintenance_md.description: New maintenance text. Pass an empty string to clear.

asset_delete_asset.name: Delete Asset
asset_delete_asset.description: Delete an asset and its associated entities.

name.name: Name
name.description: Category display name. Must be unique.

name.name: Name
name.description: New category name. Cannot be empty or duplicate.

asset_delete_category.name: Delete Category
asset_delete_category.description: Delete a category. A category that still holds assets is refused unless force is set, because deleting it deletes them too.

force.name: Force
force.description: Delete the assets filed under the category along with it. Without this the call is refused and nothing is deleted.

note_get_note.description: Get full details of a specific note.

note_export_markdown.description: Export all notes as Markdown text, grouped by category.

content.description: Markdown body of the note. Max 100000 characters.

note_update_note.description: Modify one or more fields on an existing note. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

title.name: Title
title.description: New note title. Must be unique within the category. Max 200 characters.

pinned.name: Pinned
pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned above the rest.

name.name: Name
